description: This file defines the EventRepository interface, a Spring Data JPA repository for managing Event entities with custom query methods for filtering events by time and client.

classes.name: EventRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for Event entities with custom finder methods.

methods.name: findByTimeAfter
methods.description: Finds all Events that occur after a specified LocalDateTime.

methods.name: findByTimeBetween
methods.description: Finds all Events that occur between two specified LocalDateTime instances.

methods.name: findByClient
methods.description: Finds all Events associated with a specific Client.
